*Workflow:* set Status to **In progress** before starting, inspect current
HEAD before writing code, and stop at **Review** with a pull request linked
to this issue. Only Astra merges, closes release parent issues, or performs
release actions. If inspection at HEAD shows this issue is already satisfied
or has become wrong, do not write duplicate code — report it to Astra for
closure or rewrite.
